systems_changed.change_summary: Haunt base bounty and growth rise 10% while Haunt HP and damage also rise 10%, making camps both richer and more punishing to clear.
driving_changes: Haunts base bounty and growth increased by 10%
Haunts HP and Damage output increased by 10%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Off-lane farm is now the highest-value income on the map, but only for comps that clear grouped, chasing camps without bleeding HP. Weak-clear/single-target heroes fall further behind the AoE/sustain clearers, widening the coverage gap the KB already flagged.

systems_changed.change_summary: A three-part anti-snowball package: non-hero comeback gold cap rises 26%→30%, Haunted Souls secure up to 50% faster when behind (max at 20% NW gap), and the behind-multiplier now also feeds tick souls to the two poorest players.
driving_changes: Comeback gold from non-hero sources increased from a max of 26% to 30% (when behind by ~20% Net Worth)
Haunted Souls secure rate is now up to 50% faster than baseline based on how far behind you are in Net Worth compared to the enemy team's average (max rate at a 20% Net Worth gap)
The bonus NPC souls multiplier when behind now also increases tick souls for the 2 poorest players
systems_changed.effect_on_play: This directly reverses the KB's 'leads stick' read: losing teams now convert camp souls more reliably and get passive tick catch-up, so a farm lead is a soft lead. It rewards teams that keep farming from behind instead of conceding, and lengthens games.

systems_changed.change_summary: Baseline secure rate is 25% slower, but scales up to 50% faster than baseline the further behind you are in net worth.
driving_changes: Haunted Souls secure rate is now 25% slower
Haunted Souls secure rate is now up to 50% faster than baseline based on how far behind you are in Net Worth compared to the enemy team's average (max rate at a 20% Net Worth gap)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Contested camp souls become a skill/timing check for the leader (slower baseline secure = easier to steal) and a gift for the trailing team. It makes camp contests less of a straight stat-check and more of a comeback lever.

systems_changed.change_summary: Breakables growth values drop 10%, while new Halloween Cauldrons (broken with Heavy Melee) drop Candy granting a temporary Sugar Rush buff.
driving_changes: With a Heavy Melee, break the cauldron to pick up a piece of Candy and stash it in your pocket for later... consume the candy to grant yourself a boost of energy with the temporary Sugar Rush buff
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Crate scaling is trimmed, so Heavy Melee crate routes pay slightly less late, but Cauldrons add a fresh Heavy Melee-gated pickup that rewards the same frontline/tank kits with a stashed tempo buff. Heavy Melee access stays a real economy skill.

systems_changed.change_summary: Healing Snacks heal rises from 10% to 14% max HP.
driving_changes: Healing Snacks heal increased from 10% Max HP to 14%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Camps and extended off-lane routes are more survivable, reinforcing sustain bruisers and tanks who already clear Haunts; it slightly lowers the cost of contesting hubs and Buff Containers.

systems_changed.system: Movement / Steam Vents / tunnels / air drag
systems_changed.change_summary: Steam Vents are reworked to grant +150% stamina regen (from the KB's invisibility roams), tunnel move speed drops +70%→+50%, and the slow-to-air-drag ratio rises 0.35→0.5.
driving_changes: Steam Vents now increase stamina regeneration by 150%
Move speed in tunnels reduced from +70% to +50%
Move slow to air drag ratio increased from 0.35 to 0.5
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Vents shift from a stealth-gank tool to a stamina/kiting tool, cutting the free approach angle roamers had; tunnel rotations slow, tightening map tempo; and the higher air-drag ratio taxes flyers harder whenever they're slowed.

systems_changed.change_summary: The latest six heroes lose 'new' status, gaining normal ranked unlock requirements and becoming bannable.
driving_changes: Latest 6 heroes are no longer categorized as "new" anymore. This means they have normal hero unlocking requirements for ranked and can now be banned.
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Ranked draft can now suppress the strongest of the recent six, so their pick/win rates should compress toward the field; it also raises the barrier to entry on those kits in ranked.

tempo_shift.why: The comeback package (non-hero comeback gold 26%→30%, Haunted Souls securing up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) plus trimmed breakable growth directly softens leads the KB said were sticking, giving trailing teams a farm-based path back. Richer-but-tougher Haunts reward sustained farming over early lane tempo.

archetype_effects.why: Heavy Melee Cauldrons add a new candy/Sugar Rush pickup and Healing Snacks 10%→14% makes camp chip damage cheaper to absorb.
Comeback gold 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls secure when behind, and tick souls to the poorest give trailing scalers a real catch-up route.
Steam Vents reworked from invisibility to stamina regen removes the free approach, and tunnels +70%→+50% slows rotations.
Higher air-drag ratio (0.35→0.5) taxes flyers harder under slows, and slower tunnel speed blunts long-range repositioning.
Breakables growth -10% trims crate scaling, offset by Cauldron Heavy Melee value; net roughly flat.
Breakables growth -10% and slower tunnel rotations reduce the value of shoving-and-rotating over farming Haunts.

systems.intent_read: Valve is deliberately re-opening the comeback valve it closed in prior patches: the multi-pronged behind-team package (gold cap, Haunted Souls secure, tick souls) plus trimmed breakable growth targets the 'leads stick' problem the KB flagged. The Haunt bounty/HP bump and Cauldrons push income further off-lane and toward Heavy Melee/AoE clearers, while the Steam Vent and tunnel changes pull back the free-roam gank tempo that made corridors so strong.

items.summary: Base bullet velocity 60→45% makes the cheap T2 pickup land fewer max-range shots; upgrades keep their velocity, so the cut bites the early lane-poke window, not the finished build. Poke carries who open on it feel it most in the first ten minutes.

affected_heroes.why: Gun-poke build opens HVR for max-range trading; slower bullets cost early picks.
Hybrid owl opens HVR; velocity loss hurts his long-range lane poke.
Carbine sniper core; slower bullets make max-range carbine picks less reliable.
HVR is his lone weapon staple; velocity cut trims his poke.

items.build_shift: Pushes buyers to upgrade faster to recover velocity rather than sit on the base item.

items.summary: 5% off secondary-fire damage and growth trims the carbine-crit payoff; Paradox's sniper line and Viscous's spirit-hybrid poke lose top-end, not identity.

affected_heroes.why: Express Shot rewards carbine crits in her sniper build.
Spirit-hybrid Splatter/Punch shell runs Express Shot.

items.summary: +0.5s slow extends the stick on a close-range item; helps melee/close bruisers hold a target but won't move it into core.

affected_heroes.why: Close-range bruiser who wants targets stuck in melee range.

items.summary: Requiring line of sight removes the through-wall shred that made this a frontline stat-check; buyers now only get value on targets they can actually see, so it's weaker in corridor and objective fights where walls break LOS.

affected_heroes.why: Melee brawler core; loses the through-wall shred in clumped fights.
Gun-tank core; aura no longer reaches targets behind cover.
Late spirit-burst build runs Hunter's Aura for shred.

rows.text: No longer affects enemies through walls

items.summary: Trades fire rate and melee damage for a bigger +50% ambush weapon-damage amp that needs 6s stealthed to charge and now applies to the ability that breaks stealth — a slower, burstier ambush. With Steam Vents losing invisibility this patch, Shadow Weave is again the only invis-engage tool, partly offsetting the tempo cost.

affected_heroes.why: Bigger ambush amp but the 6s buildup slows his walk-up cage; regains exclusivity as vents lose invis.

items.build_shift: Becomes a pure gun-carry ambush item rather than a melee/cage tool.

affected_heroes.why: Burn gun-carry leans on Toxic Bullets for anti-heal.
On-hit gun build uses Toxic Bullets vs tanks.

80→85% weapon damage nudges the glass-cannon capstone; still a win-more late buy.
+2 spirit power from component changes is a token recovery after the 09-16 gutting; Infernus already dropped it, so it stays a fringe slot.

affected_heroes.why: Already dropped it post-09-16; small recovery won't restore it.

items.summary: -35→-40% anti-heal adds to the patch's anti-heal stack; marginal on its own.
-15→-12% damage penalty is a small relief, but the 09-16 nerf (souls/min, net-worth counting) still leaves it unbuyable.
+4s cooldown and -5m range cut both the uptime and the reach of a spirit poke/sap tool; whoever used it to chip from range loses a real chunk of value.
-10→-12% dash-distance slow makes the slow slightly harder to dash out of; small.

The regen sustain shell Baba, Lady Geist, Shiv, Celeste and Kelvin build around is materially weaker; spirit-stackers lose the most.

~98% buy; spirit Soul-Exchange variant loses most.
Rival sustain trimmed, but his own regen layer also shrinks.

items.build_shift: Pushes sustain toward lifesteal items (Spirit/Bullet Lifesteal, Leech buffed) and Healing Booster's out-of-combat regen.

items.summary: +40 bonus health makes the silence utility item a slightly better frontline buy; won't change its role.
18→22% melee resistance helps the spirit-bruiser frontlines survive melee dives a touch better.
Post-cast 0.5→0.2s tightens the double-cast window, making the reset item's combo execution faster for every buyer; it's the meta's connective item, so this quietly speeds up the whole caster roster.

affected_heroes.why: Echo Shard bomb combo executes faster.
Reset combos benefit from shorter lockout.

items.summary: -5s cooldown plus the barrier-damage fix makes the spirit-amp slightly more reliable; still a situational standoff pick.
Now scaling 0.35 off spirit power turns a flat-damage item into a spirit-build tool, and the extra dash slow helps it stick; spirit casters gain a real option, gun builds lose interest.
items.build_shift: Moves from a flat-damage pickup to a spirit-scaling slot competing with other spirit poke items.

items.summary: Parry cooldown reduction drops from -1.75s to -1.25s, so you parry less often — a straight trim to the parry-utility item despite the buff tag.
18→22% weapon damage strengthens Venator's gun-bruiser core and any frontline M1 build; small but on a core slot.

+4% weapon damage and +2% lifesteal make the cheap T2 sustain item a better early buy; Venator and Infernus get more from their lane-sustain slot, and it competes harder with the regen items just nerfed.

affected_heroes.why: Standard early lifesteal on gun carries.

items.build_shift: Absorbs some of the demand lost by Radiant Regeneration/Healing Booster nerfs.

items.summary: Multiple Healbanes now stack with diminishing returns — a team-wide anti-heal buff — but heal-on-kill drops 275→170+3/boon, cutting the self-sustain that made it a solo bruiser pick. Net: better as a team anti-heal tool, worse as personal sustain.

affected_heroes.why: Team anti-heal up, personal heal-on-kill down.
Anti-heal doubles as sustain; kill-heal trimmed.

affected_heroes.why: Extra Regen/Healing Booster core loses its cheap upgrade path and flat regen.
Spirit bruiser runs Healing Booster for sustain.
Sustain stack leans on Healing Booster.

items.summary: +2 spirit power and +2% lifesteal strengthen the spirit-carry sustain slot; Seven and Victor get more out of it, and it absorbs some of the demand regen items just lost.

+8→+15 health regen nearly doubles the regen on the item; helps sustained frontline buyers but won't make it core.
+2% on both lifesteals is a small nudge; KB already had it losing to cheaper lifesteal, and this doesn't change that.
More active lifesteal, bullet lifesteal and weapon damage make the burst-steroid a stronger all-in tool for aggressive carries.

build_changes: Move sustain off Radiant Regeneration toward Spirit/Bullet Lifesteal and Leech, which were all buffed.
Keep Torment Pulse and Decay; they gained while his regen layer lost.
heroes.one_liner: Knives hit tanks harder, but the regen shell that kept him alive got gutted.

indirect_reasons: Healing Booster loses its Extra Regen component and +3 flat regen, gutting the cheap upgrade path her heal/anti-heal build sits on.
Anti-heal is the patch's clearest theme (Decay 55%, Toxic Bullets 40%, Healbane stacking), which cuts directly into her tether healing.
Healing Snacks 10%→14% max HP cheapens the dedicated healing she sells.
Her actual primary gun core (Titanic Magazine, Tesla Bullets, Active Reload) is untouched, which caps the damage.
build_changes: Buy Healing Booster standalone rather than as an Extra Regen upgrade, or drop it for buffed lifesteal in the heal build.
heroes.one_liner: Best peel in the game, but every heal item she bought got worse.

direct_reasons: Alchemical Flask travels 40% faster and its weapon-damage reduction rises -25%→-30%, making his poke land and stick.
Willpower speed bonus +15%→+20% improves his walk-up to the silence cage.
Last Stand T2 goes +40.5→+50 DPS and -30s→-40s cooldown, a real mid-game power spike.
indirect_reasons: Steam Vents lose invisibility, restoring Shadow Weave as the only invis-engage tool — the exclusivity the KB said he had lost.
Shadow Weave's rework (+50% ambush weapon damage, applies to the breaking ability) suits his gun-carry ambush more than the old melee/fire-rate version.
Tempo shift toward scaling plus the comeback package (gold cap 30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind) gives his late gun spike room to arrive.
High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60%→45% trims his early poke; Spirit Lifesteal +2 spirit/+2% lifesteal helps his sustain slot.
build_changes: Shadow Weave is back to being a real core in the cage-bruiser line — but plan the 6s stealth buildup before engaging.
Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds faster to offset the velocity cut.
heroes.one_liner: Got his invis-engage back and a real Last Stand spike; still waits on a clock.

direct_reasons: Flying Slash cast range 26m→23m and T3 +15m→+8m shorten her engage and escape reach.
Shadow Transformation cooldown 150s→160s (moved to T2) delays her fight-winning window.
Power Slash spirit scaling +6% is a small damage gain on her primary damage tool.
indirect_reasons: Hunter's Aura now requires line of sight, removing the through-wall shred her late spirit-burst build buys it for.
Torment Pulse melee resistance 18%→22% buffs her late spirit build; Healbane rework is neutral for her.
Haunt bounty +10% and tougher camps reward her punch AoE, still the fastest grouped-camp clear in the game.
Mobile assassin archetype down (vents lose invisibility, tunnels +70%→+50%) trims the roam tempo she lives on.
build_changes: Re-evaluate Hunter's Aura in the late spirit-burst line; it no longer shreds through walls in corridor fights.
heroes.one_liner: Spirit scaling is up, but grapple range is shorter, targets see it coming, and the ult cooldown is longer.

rows.label: Target mark
rows.text: Shows when the grapple is cast

direct_reasons: Grapple T3 now also grants +4m jump velocity — a small mobility gain on his engage.
Death Slam's cone-to-cylinder indicator is visual only.
indirect_reasons: Steam Vents lose invisibility (now +150% stamina regen), removing the free dive approach the KB credits with extending his routes.
Tunnel move speed +70%→+50% slows the rotations that set up Ground Strike.
The comeback package (gold cap 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) blunts the early snowball an S-tier tempo initiator converts.
Haunt bounty +10% pays camp clearers; Lash has no AoE farm route to take it.
heroes.one_liner: Small Grapple buff in the notes; Steam Vents losing invisibility is what costs him.

direct_reasons: Splatter T1 +36→+45 damage and alt-fire damage growth +5% per boon lift his primary poke shell.
Goo Ball fixes remove the heavy-melee/Ethereal Shift tech during cast delay — a small loss of outplay.
indirect_reasons: Express Shot secondary fire damage and growth -5% and High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60%→45% both hit his spirit-hybrid Splatter/Punch core.
Decay heal cut -50%→-55% strengthens his anti-heal enabler slot.
Tank/frontline archetype up (Healing Snacks 10%→14%, Heavy Melee Cauldrons) and Steam Vents' stamina regen suit his Cube/Goo Ball sustain.
build_changes: Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds sooner; Express Shot is now a weaker top-end.
heroes.one_liner: Splatter hits a bit harder, his hybrid item shell a bit softer.

rows.label: Bug fix
rows.text: Can't melee or use Shift during cast delay

indirect_reasons: The comeback package (non-hero gold cap 26%→30%, Haunted Souls up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) restores the bail-out his farm-and-scale line lost — the KB's stated reason he rarely spikes.
Haunt bounty +10% rewards his Monster Rounds/Cultist Sacrifice farm route.
Echo Shard post-cast 0.5s→0.2s speeds reset combos, though usage data shows it near-zero on him.
Mobile assassin archetype down (vents lose invisibility) trims the roamers that dive him.
build_changes: Farming from behind is now a legitimate path back — don't concede the camp route when losing lane.
heroes.one_liner: Finally has a comeback valve for the slow Affliction line.

direct_reasons: Traveler channel 2s→3s and cancel cooldown 4s→5s slow his rotation and escape.
Traveler now breaks on stun/immobilize/sleep/slowing hex, adding real interrupt windows against him.
Base Traveler gains the old T2 barrier (no scaling) and T3 adds 0.8 barrier spirit scaling plus damage-interrupt immunity — a genuine survivability gain.
indirect_reasons: Toxic Bullets anti-heal 35%→40% buffs his spirit-amp hybrid core; Healbane rework is neutral for him.
Split pusher archetype down (breakables growth -10%, tunnels +70%→+50%) trims his map-play income.
The comeback package helps a late scaler, but his problem is income conversion, not catch-up.
build_changes: Treat Traveler as a defensive/barrier tool rather than a free rotation — the 3s channel is punishable.
heroes.one_liner: Tankier Traveler, slower Traveler; the split-push economy still doesn't pay him.

rows.label: Teamplay
rows.text: Allies see your targeting and destination

indirect_reasons: Her two worst lanes both moved against her: Warden got flask travel speed, -30% weapon-damage reduction and Willpower +20%, and Billy got Rising Ram T3 +15%/20s and Blasted 27s->25s.
Two other counters softened: Mo & Krill's spirit damage on all abilities -10% blunts the Combo that lifts her, and Wraith lost Card Trick heal 60->45 and Project Mind cooldown 46s->50s.
Bullet Resilience 30%->35% bullet resist is a small tax on a pure-gun kit, partly offset by Glass Cannon 80%->85%.
heroes.one_liner: No direct change; Warden and Billy got stronger, M&K and Wraith weaker - roughly flat.

indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds bullet velocity 60%->45% hits the ~79% HVR/Opening Rounds lane opener that is his only real lane pressure.
His dive counters got direct buffs: Drifter base gun damage +3% and Eternal Night T3 +2.75s, Calico Leaping Slash T3 +90 and Ava T3 8s.
Lightning Scroll now scales 0.35 off spirit power, giving his duration/cooldown spirit shell a poke option it did not have.
build_changes: Delay the HVR lane opener or accept weaker max-range poke; consider Lightning Scroll as a spirit-scaling poke slot in the duration build.
heroes.one_liner: HVR lane package nerfed and his dive counters buffed; still a coin-flip C.

indirect_reasons: Haunt bounty +10% rewards her grouped-camp AoE clear, and the comeback package (gold cap 26%->30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind) helps a 44.8% WR hero.
Steam Vents losing invisibility removes the free dive approach the KB credited her, and tunnels +70%->+50% slows her roam.
Her worst lane Ivy lost Healing Booster's Extra Regen component and flat +3 regen, but Victor gained Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser and Torment Pulse buffs and Billy got Rising Ram T3 +15%/20s.
heroes.one_liner: AoE camp clear pays more, but vents lost invis and her tank counters got tankier.

direct_reasons: Base gun damage +3% and Bloodscent T3 +11%->+12% amplified damage sharpen the melee-proc trade he already wins early.
Eternal Night T3 +2.5s->+2.75s extends his ult window slightly.
indirect_reasons: Decay heal cut -50%->-55% strengthens his anti-heal bruiser variant, and Healbane now stacking makes team anti-heal a real lever.
Healing Snacks 10%->14% max HP and the new Heavy-Melee Cauldrons reward his melee core and camp-chip sustain.
Mo & Krill's spirit damage -10% softens one of his listed counters; Apollo's Riposte is now an immobilize rather than a stun, so it no longer fully locks his dive.
build_changes: Anti-heal bruiser variant gains: Decay is now a stronger slot into sustain comps.
heroes.one_liner: Small gun/T3 buffs plus Decay and anti-heal stacking - still a blind-pick bruiser.

direct_reasons: Ira Domini blessed stake damage 115->95 but boon scaling 3->3.6: a weaker early stake that overtakes the old value later, so his lane poke is trimmed and his mid-game is not.
Battle Vest weapon damage 18%->22% and Bullet Lifesteal 6%->10% weapon damage / 13%->15% lifesteal both buff his gun-bruiser primary shell.
indirect_reasons: Graves - his hard counter whose gun deletes his traps - took move speed 7->6.7, bullet damage per boon -4% and a slower Grasping Hands deploy.
High-Velocity Rounds 60%->45% does not touch him (he opens Restorative Shot/Close Quarters/Monster Rounds), while it does hit Vindicta, another listed counter.
Warden (flask, Willpower, Last Stand T2) and Abrams (base gun damage +5%, Siphon T3 +22) both got stronger, and both are losing lanes for him.
build_changes: Lean harder into Battle Vest + Bullet Lifesteal as the lane-sustain spine; treat Ira Domini as a mid-game spike rather than an early bully tool.
heroes.one_liner: Battle Vest and Bullet Lifesteal buffs offset a weaker early stake; Graves nerf helps.

direct_reasons: Aura of Suffering T3 +15%->+16% damage is a token bump on his grind-down frontline.
indirect_reasons: Three of his core sustain items were buffed: Spirit Lifesteal 6->8 spirit / 13%->15%, Infuser 70%->75% active lifesteal and 6->8 spirit, Torment Pulse 18%->22% melee resist.
Healing Booster lost its Extra Regen component and flat +3 regen, which is a real hit to his sustain stack - the buffs above roughly cancel it.
Harder Haunt camps (bounty and HP both +10%) and Healing Snacks 10%->14% both reward his camp-grinding sustain line; Ivy, his worst lane, lost the same healing items.
build_changes: Shift sustain weight from Healing Booster to Spirit Lifesteal/Infuser; keep Torment Pulse as the frontline layer.
heroes.one_liner: Spirit Lifesteal/Infuser/Torment Pulse buffs beat the Healing Booster trim - still A.

direct_reasons: Base bullet damage 35->32 is a ~9% cut to the level-1 lane pressure that is her entire identity; the growth buff 0.52->0.61 only breaks even around boon 33, so she is weaker at every realistic point.
Bookwyrm T2 trail duration +2s->+1s trims her zone control.
indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds bullet velocity 60%->45% hits her 1.2-minute lane opener directly.
The comeback package (non-hero gold cap 26%->30%, Haunted Souls up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) directly attacks the lane-win-then-snowball conversion that made her S.
Breakables growth -10% trims the lane-adjacent crate routes she converts lane pressure into; Healing Snacks 10%->14% partly offsets by letting her lane pressure stick.
build_changes: Do not sit on base HVR for max-range poke; upgrade it faster or open Opening Rounds first. Expect to win lane by less and convert through crate routes rather than a kill snowball.
heroes.one_liner: Lane damage cut and comeback souls restored - her snowball converts less.

direct_reasons: Luggage Cart T2 wall-impact damage +75->+90 and T3 cooldown -15s->-18s are both straight buffs to his setup tool.
indirect_reasons: The comeback package helps a 45.4% WR hero that loses to tempo rather than to numbers.
His listed counters Yamato (Power Slash spirit scaling +6%) and Lash (Grapple T3 +4m jump velocity) both got small buffs, so the dive that beats his setup did not get slower.
heroes.one_liner: Luggage Cart buffs are real but small; still a setup initiator in a tempo meta.

direct_reasons: Rising Ram T3 +10% max health for 16s -> +15% for 20s is a real frontline durability buff on his engage.
Blasted cooldown 27s->25s gives slightly more uptime on his all-in.
indirect_reasons: Spirit Shielding 18%->15% spirit resist trims his spirit shred/slow variant's defensive layer.
Decay -50%->-55% heal cut strengthens his anti-heal frontline role in a patch that pushes anti-heal hard.

His worst lane Shiv is roughly flat (Serrated Knives rage 3.5%->4% current HP up, alt-fire per boon -5% and Killing Blow recast 16s->12s down), while Warden and Seven both got small buffs against him.
heroes.one_liner: Rising Ram T3 and Blasted buffs, but Warden and Shiv still out-sustain him.

direct_reasons: Move speed 7->6.7 and bullet damage per boon -4% cut both her kiting and her damage on a hero with the worst early game of any carry.
Grasping Hands deploy 0.6s->0.8s and now more easily double-jumped over removes a chunk of the zoning that keeps divers off her.
Borrowed Decree T2 loses -0.3s spawn time and T3 gains it - a straight delay to her summon tempo.
indirect_reasons: Echo Shard post-cast 0.5s->0.2s buffs her summoner/cooldown primary build's double-cast execution.
The comeback package (gold cap 26%->30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) is the bail-out her ~25-minute window never had.
Her counters split: Warden buffed (flask, Willpower, Last Stand T2) and Calico buffed (Leaping Slash T3 +90, Ava T3 8s), but Wraith nerfed (Card Trick heal 60->45, Project Mind 46s->50s).
build_changes: Echo Shard is now a faster, more reliable core in the summoner build; lean on it rather than on Grasping Hands zoning for safety.
heroes.one_liner: Top win rate ate a broad nerf; Echo Shard buff and comeback souls soften it.

direct_reasons: Riposte Pommel Hit disable 0.8s->1.5s (T2 +0.4s->+0.6s) nearly doubles his lockdown window, even though it is now an immobilize plus parry disable rather than a stun.
Riposte dash fixes stop the counterattack whiffing on moving, cornered or displaced targets - reliability he did not have.
Flawless Advance now refunds the stab and keeps remaining recasts when stunned or slept, and Itani Lo Sahn is no longer interrupted by Sleep - two hard removals of his worst punish windows.
indirect_reasons: Stun to immobilize is the main change: immobilize does not interrupt channeled ults such as Seven, Bebop and Harrow, so he loses that answer.
Healing Booster losing its Extra Regen component and flat +3 regen thins the sustain shell his spirit bruiser build leans on.
Healbane now stacking is a team anti-heal gain but its heal-on-kill 275->170+3/boon is a personal sustain loss - roughly neutral for him.
His losing lanes split: Warden and Abrams both buffed, but Wraith (Card Trick heal, Project Mind cooldown) and Mo & Krill (spirit damage -10%) both nerfed.
build_changes: Re-weight sustain toward Restorative Locket/Dispel Magic rather than Healing Booster; the longer Riposte disable makes pick-oriented spirit burst better than the old tank-and-outlast line.
heroes.one_liner: Riposte no longer stuns: it immobilizes and disables parry, so it can't interrupt channels. Longer disable softens it.

indirect_reasons: Healing Booster no longer builds from Extra Regen and loses its flat +3 regen - the backbone of his sustain layer is gone.
Divine Barrier cooldown 45s->55s cuts a cast window per fight off his best-WR late item.
Decay -50%->-55% heal cut is a small gain on his anti-heal slot, and the comeback package helps a 45.1% WR hero; his worst lane Ivy lost the same healing items.
build_changes: Stop treating Healing Booster as a cheap Extra Regen upgrade; buy it standalone or route the slot into Spirit Lifesteal, which was buffed.
heroes.one_liner: Healing Booster and Divine Barrier both trimmed; his sustain shell is thinner.

direct_reasons: Base health regen 2.5→3 is trivial on a tank that already builds Restorative Shot/Melee Lifesteal.
Go For The Throat now counts Point Blank and Opening Rounds weapon damage, and Point Blank's slow went 2s→2.5s — that combo is now a real damage package, not a flex.
Both Entangling Bola fixes (Unstoppable flyers, Grey Talon during Rain of Arrows) make her grounding reliable, which matters into Vindicta/Grey Talon/Danny.
indirect_reasons: Hunter's Aura now needs line of sight — the through-wall shred she bought it for in clumped fights is gone (core gun-tank slot).
Spirit Shielding 18%→15% spirit resist trims a core defensive layer into a spirit-burst patch.
Anti-heal is the patch's clearest theme (Decay/Toxic Bullets/Crippling Headshot up, Healbane stacking) and it attacks her Melee Lifesteal/Restorative Shot sustain directly.

Counter-side offsets: Rat King (62% vs her) ate a huge nerf, the mobile-assassin archetype is down (Steam Vents lose invis, tunnels +70%→+50%), and the tank/frontline archetype is up (Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10%→14%).
build_changes: Buy Point Blank as a core slot: its slow extends and its weapon damage now feeds Go For The Throat.
Deliberately delay Hunter's Aura — it no longer shreds through walls, so it is an LOS-fight item only now.
heroes.one_liner: Still fine, but Hunter's Aura no longer shreds through walls and the anti-heal patch bites her sustain.

rows.label: Weapon damage
rows.text: Now counts Point Blank and Opening Rounds

rows.label: Bug fixes
rows.text: Unstoppable flyers stay up; grounds Talon's ult

direct_reasons: Shining Wonder damage 140→125 is a straight cut to a kit already leaning on burst windows.
Torment Pulse's melee resist 18%→22% is the only direct-ish help, and it does not touch her problem.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration's fourth and biggest trim (spirit regen scaling 0.35→0.25, heal-on-cast 65→40, boon scaling 1.7→1.4, in-combat only) guts her core sustain shell.
Healing Booster loses Extra Regen and +3 flat regen — the second leg of that same regen stack.
Spirit Shielding 18%→15% and HVR bullet velocity 60%→45% trim her defensive and early poke items.
Anti-heal buffs (Decay -50→-55%, Toxic Bullets 35→40%, Healbane stacking) land squarely on a regen-stacking flyer, and Metal Skin's +20% gravity punishes a flyer popping it mid-air.
build_changes: Abandon the Radiant Regeneration + Healing Booster stack; pivot to the buffed Spirit Lifesteal (+2 spirit, +2% lifesteal) and Torment Pulse for in-fight sustain.
Witchmail (her highest-WR item) becomes more central now that slow/CC comps are stronger.
heroes.one_liner: Small damage nerf in the notes; the regen item cuts and anti-heal are what really hurt.

direct_reasons: Base bullet damage -5% and bullet damage growth -20% cut the gun-bruiser economy he farms with.
Scrap Grenade loses damage (70→60, T2 +70→+60, T3 300→275) and radius (8m→6m, large explosion 14m→10m) — the camp-clear and teamfight AoE both shrink.
Rule, Ratannia! loses half its knockup, 20s cooldown (160→180), radius (20m→16m, T2 +8→+6m) and duration (12s→9s), and now goes on cooldown if he is stunned/slept before placing.
Fuse timers +0.1s give targets an extra beat to step out; only the new 0.4s minimum melee-fuse helps him.
indirect_reasons: Haunt camps gained +10% HP and damage while his Scrap Grenade radius shrank — the AoE-clear income advantage he was rated S for is materially slower.
Richer-but-tougher Haunts plus the comeback package (gold cap 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind) soften the lead he converts from crate/camp tempo.
Offset: Heavy Melee Cauldrons hand his 116-heavy-melee frontline a new pickup, and Healing Snacks 10%→14% keeps his brawl sustain ticking.
build_changes: Stop counting Scrap Grenade as a one-button camp clear; pull camps with melee first, then drop grenade on clumped mobs.
Superior/Compress Cooldown become mandatory again to cover the 180s banner cooldown.
heroes.one_liner: Grenade radius and the banner ult both got hit hard — still a frontline, no longer an auto-win.

rows.label: If stunned first
rows.text: Goes on cooldown; flag drops with no impact

direct_reasons: Baba's Brew has no initial brew time but the order is now random each cast and the cycle went 1s→1.5s — she can no longer guarantee the silence/barrier she needs on demand, and silence dropped 3s→2.75s.
Spirit Resist scaling 0.1→0.07 plus Threadsap's spirit-steal duration 22s→16s (and cleanse now wipes the stolen spirit too) cut her durability and her signature steal.
Granny Long Legs heavy-melee slow 4s→2s and light-melee knockback 10m→8m trim her melee control; the 1.4s→1.2s heavy-melee cooldown is the only real gain.
Her Granny stomp now only hits the closest Rejuvenator, so she cannot sweep the new three-crystal Mid-Boss spread.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration (94% buy) lost spirit-regeneration scaling 0.35→0.25, heal-on-cast 65→40 and in-fight availability — her regen wall is her identity.
Healing Booster lost Extra Regen and its +3 flat regen; Torment Pulse 18%→22% melee resist is nowhere near enough to offset.
Anti-heal is the patch's clearest item theme (Decay -55%, Healbane stacking, Toxic Bullets 40%) and it is aimed at exactly her archetype.
Offset: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons and Healing Snacks 10%→14% both suit her, and tougher Haunt camps reward her sustain clear.
build_changes: Leave the regen bruiser shell — Radiant Regeneration and Healing Booster are both gutted; move to the cooldown-caster line (Superior Cooldown/Duration Extender) and buy Spirit Resilience earlier.
Since brew order is random, hold casting until the right brew cycles in rather than opening fights blind.
heroes.one_liner: Random brew order plus two gutted regen items is her whole gameplan taken away.

rows.label: Cleanse
rows.text: Cleanse also removes her stolen spirit

direct_reasons: Base bullet damage 30→25 and -20% headshot damage hurt the HVR/Opening Rounds lane phase — a lane crutch he needed at a 46% win rate.
Rook Battery spirit scaling 1.3→0.9 is a real damage cut and the T3 cooldown trim softened (-12s→-10s).
Setup Bishop got the compensation: on-square spirit scaling 0.64→0.85, T1 slow +15%→+25%, T3 resist shred -2.5%→-5% per stack applied on impact, so his zone is now the damage.
Develop Queen: 210s→240s cooldown and 1s→1.2s stun-tile delay are bad, but checkmate under 100 HP is now in the base kit and T2 adds +150 threshold, plus Move Piece 50m→65m with better placement.
indirect_reasons: Three of his five losing matchups got hit: Rat King (huge nerf package), Baba (brew/regen gutted) and Celeste (Shining Wonder + regen items).
The mobile-dive archetype he dies to is down (Steam Vents lose invisibility, tunnels +70%→+50%), and Yamato's Flying Slash range 26m→23m (T3 +15→+8m) shortens the dive that beat him 38%.
Divine Barrier 45s→55s cooldown trims his situational late item, and anti-heal stacking hurts any heal/sustain layer he buys.
build_changes: Max Setup Bishop over Rook Battery — the bishop is now the damage (0.85 scaling, faster T3 shred).
Treat his gun line as a lane crutch only after the 30→25 bullet and -20% headshot cuts.
heroes.one_liner: His zone got better and his counters got nerfed, but the gun and Rook Battery both lost real damage.

rows.label: T3 shred timing
rows.text: Applies on impact, not by squares

rows.label: Placement
rows.text: Lands closer to aim, works near walls

direct_reasons: Chimera Mk1 dominates every change: jetpack unusable while cursed, cooldown reduction per boon -0.4s→-0.25s, and T3 refund on hit 50%→30% all cut his uptime.
Slows now cut the jetpack's in-air impulse more effectively — and even harder when movement abilities are silenced — which is the exact escape a dive-pick flyer needs.
Grounding pulls now work more reliably against him, so the Silver/Bola-and-slow layer lands consistently.
The Close The Deal damage bug fix (held through the ability) is the only real gain.
indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds 60%→45% bullet velocity hits his lone weapon staple in the early poke window.
Steam Vents lose invisibility, removing the free approach angle his pick play used; Shadow Weave is now the only invis-engage tool.
The global slow-to-air-drag ratio 0.35→0.5 taxes him every time he is slowed mid-flight.
Anti-heal stacking (Decay -55%, Toxic Bullets 40%) and tougher Haunt camps (+10% HP) punish a 730-HP diver who commits to clear.
build_changes: Stop treating jetpack as the disengage — slows now bite it directly; lean Reactive Barrier/Grit and only fly in when the slow is on cooldown.
Express Shot value drops with the 5% secondary-fire trim; the HVR velocity cut pushes upgrades earlier.
heroes.one_liner: Slows now eat his jetpack and Steam Vents lost invisibility — his escape got taxed twice.

rows.label: Grounding
rows.text: Pulls to ground land more reliably

rows.label: Bug fix
rows.text: Now deals damage when held through Close The Deal

direct_reasons: Abstract Landscape is nerfed across the board: 165s→180s cooldown, 6s→5s duration, spirit scaling 0.04→0.01, ends early if she dies, 0.5s→0.75s re-apply cooldown, and T3 no longer keeps ink alive.
Still Life loses reliability: stun 1.0s→0.9s, line of sight required at channel end even in the grace period, T1 regen only while drawing and scaling 0.25→0.15.
T3 stun +0.35s→+0.45s and the sketch-buff reshuffle are the only ups.
indirect_reasons: Spirit Lifesteal 6→8 spirit power and 13%→15% lifesteal is a real buff to her primary spirit-caster shell.
Anti-heal stacking (Decay -55%, Healbane stacks, Toxic Bullets 40%) directly undercuts Still Life's regen talents and any Healing Booster she buys.
The dive archetype that deletes her is down (Steam Vents lose invisibility, tunnel speed +70%→+50%), which partially offsets; Holliday/Vindicta are untouched.
build_changes: Stop leaning on Still Life T1 regen as lane sustain — it only ticks while drawing now; put the points elsewhere.
Keep Superior Cooldown + Escalating Exposure (untouched); add buffed Spirit Lifesteal for the sustain the regen talents lost.
heroes.one_liner: Her ult got cut on every axis at once — the zone is still good, the cooldown is not.

rows.label: Sketches
rows.text: Healing amp for healers, Spirit Power for three heroes

direct_reasons: Bounty halved to 1500 (+25/min) while health and health-per-minute both rise 20% and resist reductions are only 50% effective — a tankier, less rewarding kill.
Roar moved to 25% HP means the fight's dangerous phase comes later and lasts longer.
The Rejuvenator now splits into three crystals around the pit, each broken by one heavy melee, each granting a full heal and a 500 (+9/min) bounty to the breaker.
Bigger pit with more cover plus a 6s→7.5s drop time makes the payout a spread, contestable pickup rather than one centre crystal.
indirect_reasons: The crystal bounty rewards whichever frontline reaches it first — heavy-melee bruisers (Rat King, Abrams, Drifter, Baba) get paid for doing what they already do.
The halved resist-reduction effectiveness taxes armour-shred item lines against the objective, favouring raw sustained DPS and AoE comps over shred builds.
build_changes: Assign a heavy-melee frontline to crystals before the Mid-Boss dies — 500 +9/min per crystal is now the real payout.
heroes.one_liner: Bounty halved, HP up, and the Rejuvenator is now three crystals the frontline has to chase.

direct_reasons: Past Dues now channels its special attack into a ground sleep aura that stacks sleep on heroes standing in it; killing the channeler clears the aura.
Sleep turns a slow camp clear into a free gank window — a slept farmer is a stationary target for the patch's richer, more contested jungle.
indirect_reasons: Camps also gained 10% HP and damage and 10% bounty, so clear-speed heroes that kill the channeler instantly (AoE burst, grouped-camp clearers) pull further ahead of single-target clearers who eat the channel.
Apollo got two sleep-specific buffs (Itani Lo Sahn no longer interrupted by Sleep, Flawless Advance refunds the stab when slept), so he is the cleanest answer to the aura.
build_changes: Kill the channeling creature first on every Past Dues camp — the aura dies with it.
Clear camps with AoE burst rather than single-target chip; standing in the aura is what sleeps you.
heroes.one_liner: Stay in the camp too long and you get slept — kill the channeler or get ganked.

rows.label: Counterplay
rows.text: Kill the channeler to clear it

direct_reasons: Lurking Terrors is gutted: fear buildup 1.3s→2s, duration 7s→5s, T3 duration +3s→+2s, T3 immunity → 50% damage reduction while channelling, and no fear builds when she is more than 50 degrees above or below the target's view.
Base gun damage -10% and Healing Needles heal-per-shot 25→22 (T2 +20→+16) cut her throughput; only the spirit scaling 0.2→0.24 and Wretched Vapors T3 +15%→+20% rush speed go up.
Leech Therapy fed-leech ground duration drops from a flat 180s to 120s + 3s/min and leeches clear on round reset, trimming her pre-placed map presence.
indirect_reasons: Anti-heal is the patch's headline: Decay -50%→-55%, Toxic Bullets 35%→40%, Crippling Headshot -35%→-40% and Healbane now stacking — every one of them cuts a dedicated healer's output.
Healing Snacks 10%→14% max HP and the tank/frontline archetype rising cheapen the dedicated healing she sells.
Violet's Still Life sketches now grant +2% healing amp specifically from her (and Kelvin/Ivy/Dynamo/Paige/Rem), a small team-side nudge.
build_changes: Lean on the Healing Needles spirit scaling (0.2→0.24) rather than stacking flat heal-per-shot, which just got trimmed twice.
Treat Lurking Terrors as a 5s lockdown, not a 7s one — do not channel it from odd vertical angles, fear no longer builds there.
heroes.one_liner: Her ult lost duration, immunity and buildup speed in a patch where anti-heal is everywhere.

synthesis.size_why: The change count is inflated by broad tuning, but two structural moves decide it: a three-part comeback package (non-hero gold 26%→30%, Haunted Souls secure up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) reverses the 'leads stick' economy, and Radiant Regeneration plus Healing Booster being gutted in the same patch as anti-heal buffs and Healbane stacking deletes the regen-stack build family. Haunt bounty/HP/damage all +10% also reprices the entire off-lane farm the last two patches were built around.
synthesis.headline: The comeback valve is open again, and regen stacking is dead — anti-heal and lifesteal own the sustain slot now.

meta_thesis.previous: Souls sit off-lane in a coverage problem no five-man can solve; AoE clearers and Heavy Melee crate openers bank first, lane bullies convert pressure, leads stick, and tempo usually closes the lobby before a late spike.
meta_thesis.new: Off-lane farm is richer but a farm lead is now a soft lead: trailing teams secure contested Haunted Souls faster, get tick souls to their two poorest, and can farm their way back, so games run longer and sustained-farm carries and late spikes get a real window. Sustain itself migrates from regen stacking to in-fight lifesteal, because anti-heal is everywhere.
meta_thesis.why: The KB's core economic read ('comeback bounties trimmed, extra souls reroute to the two lowest-econ players, leads stick') is directly undone by non-hero comeback gold 26%→30%, Haunted Souls securing up to 50% faster at a 20% net-worth gap, and tick souls now feeding the two poorest — while the tempo assassins who converted early leads lose Steam Vent invisibility and tunnel speed +70%→+50%.

winners.why: Riposte disable 0.8s→1.5s plus dash reliability and CC refunds on Flawless Advance/Itani Lo Sahn remove his whiff windows; the longer immobilize also fits a patch where fights are picked, not sieged.

Flask travel +40% and shred -25%→-30%, Willpower +15%→+20%, and Last Stand T2 +40.5→+50 DPS with -30s→-40s cooldown — and Steam Vents losing invisibility hands Shadow Weave back its exclusivity as the only invis-engage tool.

Haunt bounty and growth +10% is the single biggest income lever and his AoE clear converts it best, while Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% and Decay -50%→-55% buff his exact core slots against the +10% camp damage.
Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser (70%→75% active, 6→8 spirit) and Torment Pulse 18%→22% melee resist all land on his slots; the Healing Booster trim is real but roughly cancelled.
Napalm T2 lifesteal 15%→20%, Concussive Combustion T3 +0.4 spirit scaling, and both Toxic Bullets 35%→40% and Decay buffed — the anti-heal patch is aimed at the fronts his burn out-ranges.

losers.why: Scrap Grenade damage and radius (8m→6m, 14m→10m) and Rule, Ratannia! (half knockup, 160s→180s, 20m→16m, 12s→9s, CD if stunned pre-place) are gutted exactly as Haunt camps gain +10% HP — his one-button clear stops being one-button.

Random brew order each cast plus 1s→1.5s cycle removes on-demand silence/barrier, and both Radiant Regeneration (~94% buy) and Healing Booster are gutted in the same patch as anti-heal buffs — the regen wall was her identity.

Her entire shell was Radiant Regeneration plus Healing Booster, both gutted, into a patch where Decay/Toxic Bullets/stacking Healbane punish regen flyers; Shining Wonder 140→125 and the 0.35→0.5 air-drag ratio compound it.

Radiant Regeneration in ~98% of her games loses spirit-regen scaling 0.35→0.25, heal-on-cast 65→40 and its out-of-combat trigger; Essence Bomb 1.22→1.35 is a real buff but it buys burst, not the grind she wins with.
Spirit per boon 1.1→0.6 plus all ability spirit damage -10% halves the stat both builds run on; +4% bullet per boon is a pivot, not a replacement.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Paige leaves S tier even though her direct nerfs read like a lane-damage trim.
non_obvious_calls.why: Base bullet damage 35→32 (growth 0.52→0.61 only breaks even around boon 33) plus the comeback package and breakables growth -10% mean she wins lane by less and converts it into less — the snowball, not the poke, was her tier.

non_obvious_calls.claim: A whole build family dies this patch, and the heroes listed for it are collateral rather than targets.
non_obvious_calls.why: Radiant Regeneration (fourth trim, in-combat only) and Healing Booster (loses Extra Regen +3 flat regen) are gutted while Decay, Toxic Bullets, Crippling Headshot and stacking Healbane all buff anti-heal — regen-stack sustain is replaced by Bullet/Spirit Lifesteal, Leech, Infuser and Vampiric Burst, so Baba/Celeste/Shiv/Lady Geist fall because their shell is gone, not because their kits were read.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The Steam Vent rework is a targeted nerf to the roam-assassin class that the last two patches had just promoted.
non_obvious_calls.why: Vents go from invisibility to +150% stamina regen and tunnels +70%→+50% speed, hitting Holliday, Calico, Lash and Bebop — heroes who bank on free approach and fast rotations — right as the comeback package blunts the early leads they convert.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Return Fire reflecting Fixation is a Haze nerf disguised as a tank item buff.
non_obvious_calls.why: Her stacking DoT is her only real scaling line, and the KB already flags her T4 gun items as the ceiling; putting a targeted counter-item on every frontline means she can no longer close kills into tanks alone.

uncertainties: Whether the comeback package actually flips leads or just lengthens games — the KB's prior comeback bounties were trimmed because they didn't move the needle.
Net effect of Haunt bounty +10% against HP and damage +10%: richer camps may still net-lose income for weak clearers, widening the coverage gap the KB already flagged rather than narrowing it.
How strong the new Halloween Cauldron Candy/Sugar Rush buff is — no numbers were given, so the frontline value is a guess.
Nurse Harrow's KB entry is thin and I have no prior tier, so my C-lean read is low confidence.
Whether the Rat King and Baba nerfs overshoot: both were tuned down in prior patches, so stacking another cut could bench them outright.
what_to_watch: Average game length — the cleanest test of whether the comeback valve actually slows tempo.
Win rate of teams down 5k+ net worth at 15 minutes, before and after — that single number settles the comeback debate.
Radiant Regeneration and Healing Booster pick rates versus Bullet/Spirit Lifesteal and Leech — the build-family migration in one chart.
Rat King and Baba win rates at their new tiers: if they stay near 50%, the nerfs were cosmetic; if they crater, the regen-stack removal was the real killer.
Post-rework Steam Vent kill participation and tunnel-rotation frequency — did removing invisibility actually reduce gank rate, or did stamina regen replace it?
Per-Haunt-type bounty and clear time: if one camp type dominates now that bounties are up 10%, farm routes re-converge and the no-memorization intent fails.
High-MMR anti-heal item purchase rate (Decay/Toxic Bullets/Healbane) — a spike confirms sustain comps are being punished structurally, not just on paper.

verdicts.one_liner: Heal cut and a slower escape on a falling hero — commit to pure gun or fall behind.
verdicts.direct: Card Trick heal 60→45 removes the self-sustain that kept her alive through dives, and Project Mind 46s→50s with a 0.75s→1s cast makes her one escape slower on both ends.
verdicts.indirect: Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% plus +2 spirit is a real lift to her sustain-gun variant exactly as the patch's anti-heal theme (Decay, Toxic Bullets, stacking Healbane) devalues in-kit healing — the item, not the ability, is now her sustain.
build_adjustments: Drop the on-hit spirit package; build the pure fire-rate gun line (Rapid Rounds, Swift Striker, Ricochet).
Buy Spirit Lifesteal as your sustain slot instead of leaning on Card Trick.
Do not burn Project Mind to rotate — at 50s it is your only answer to a dive.

verdicts.one_liner: Got his invis-engage back and a real Last Stand spike; the slower meta finally fits him.
verdicts.direct: Flask travel +40% and shred -25%→-30% make his poke land and stick, Willpower +15%→+20% speeds the walk-up to the cage, and Last Stand T2 +40.5→+50 DPS with -40s cooldown is a genuine mid-game spike.
verdicts.indirect: Steam Vents losing invisibility hands Shadow Weave back its exclusivity as the only invis-engage, and the comeback package (30% gold, faster Haunted Souls from behind) plus longer games give a late gun scaler the clock he never got.
build_adjustments: Rekey Shadow Weave as a core in the cage-bruiser line — and plan the 6s stealthed buildup before you engage.
Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds early; velocity 60%→45% trims his poke.
Take Last Stand T2 first for the -40s cooldown and DPS spike.
